'''Fission bombs''' were a kind of [[Nuclear weapon/Legends|nuclear bomb]] that were used at the beginning of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. The crew of the [[Poison Moon (starship)|''Poison Moon'']] used some in destroying [[The Home]].
